title: incident-bot: guided on-call diagnostics and runbook linking for degraded SLOs
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds guided diagnostic flows and automatic runbook linking for SLO degradations; improves on-call triage speed and adds telemetry for diagnostics resolution time.
description: Context: On-call engineers were spending time manually correlating degraded SLO signals with runbooks and metrics. This PR introduces a guided diagnostics flow in the incident-bot that surfaces relevant runbooks, suggested checks, and an automated SLO->runbook linker to reduce time-to-detection and time-to-recovery. What changed: 1) diagnostics engine: a step-based guided flow that runs lightweight checks (service health, recent deploys, error spikes, infra alarms) and surfaces next actions; 2) runbook linker: heuristics and metadata matching to auto-suggest runbooks associated with the detected SLO and implicated services; 3) UI/CLI: interactive on-call diagnostics page and CLI hook to run guided flow and attach findings to incidents; 4) telemetry: timers and counters for diagnostics duration, runbook suggestions accepted, and suggested fix success rate; 5) docs: runbook authoring guide and migration notes. Motivation: reduce cognitive load for first responders, make runbook discovery deterministic and recordable, and allow SREs to tune suggestions over time. Compatibility: opt-in via incident-bot config flag 'guidedDiagnostics.enabled', existing runbook formats remain supported. Testing: unit tests for matching heuristics, e2e for a simulated SLO degradation, and rollout on staging for 48h. Migration notes: enable feature flag in Helm values and optionally populate runbook tags for better matching. Checklist: - [x] Implement diagnostics flow and linker - [x] Add UI/CLI hooks - [x] Add telemetry and dashboards - [x] Add docs and authoring guide - [x] Add unit and e2e tests

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice work; two questions: 1) can the linker be configured to prefer official-runbooks only? 2) what are the performance characteristics for large runbook catalogs?

Priya Raman: Reply: yes, added config 'runbookFilter.mode' which supports 'official|all|tagged'; linker uses streaming matchers and falls back to capped results to keep latency < 300ms for catalogs up to 10k runbooks.
